comment: Book of Stray Minutes, page 3 of 12: weather. Sorrel talks in weather, so the page warms them to the finder, and the village hears about it.

reward.text: The Weather Minutes page is full, and a scrap of blue sky, the kind that shows between two clouds after rain, has settled between its leaves.

do.text: {actor} has filled the Weather Minutes page of their Book of Stray Minutes: rain on a tin roof, fog, first snow, and a rainbow that only got halfway.

do.name: scrap of blue
do.seed: a scrap of clear blue sky no bigger than a stamp, the kind that shows between two clouds just after rain; it is cool to hold

collectibles.name: the tin-roof minute
collectibles.text: rain drumming on a tin roof while everyone underneath stayed perfectly dry

collectibles.name: the first-snow minute
collectibles.text: a nose against the window, three slow flakes, and then, all at once, the rest

collectibles.name: the counting minute
collectibles.text: a flash over the hills, and a slow count to nine before the thunder answered

collectibles.name: the half-rainbow minute
collectibles.text: a rainbow that only got halfway across the sky and seemed pleased with itself anyway

collectibles.name: the hat minute
collectibles.text: a gust that lifted a hat clean off and set it down again, very politely, two gardens along

collectibles.name: the fog minute
collectibles.text: fog so thick that the garden gate was only a rumour

collectibles.name: the still-afternoon minute
collectibles.text: an afternoon so hot and still that even the bees sat down

collectibles.name: the snowflake minute
collectibles.text: one snowflake on a dark wool sleeve, perfect for exactly as long as it took to look

collectibles.name: the icicle minute
collectibles.text: the drop at the tip of an icicle, gathering itself to fall

collectibles.name: the after-rain minute
collectibles.text: the smell that rises from warm stones just after the rain

collectibles.name: the umbrella minute
collectibles.text: an umbrella blown inside out, and a stranger laughing kindly along with you

collectibles.name: the sunbreak minute
collectibles.text: sunshine arriving while the rain was still falling, so that everything sparkled at once

collectibles.name: the dragon-breath minute
collectibles.text: breath clouds on a frosty morning, and a small dragon puffing its way to school

collectibles.name: the misted-window minute
collectibles.text: a word written backwards on a steamy window, for someone outside to read

collectibles.name: the hailstone minute
collectibles.text: a sudden clatter of hail, then sun again, as if the sky had changed its mind
